name: Background beat task missed schedule (general)
query: N/A — would require a per-task last-run-timestamp gauge for every Celery beat task, not only reporting.
threshold: no recorded run within 2x the task's scheduled interval
notes: The only last-run gauge Phase 5 emits is sacco_report_last_run_timestamp, and it is scoped to the reporting beat tasks only (see reporting-beat-missed.json for the backed alert covering that case). Other scheduled beat tasks — notification dispatch, signing-key rotation, business-gauge emission, search-index reconciliation, the deleted-doc sweep, subscription past-due/suspension sweeps, fee assessment — emit no last-run gauge at all. A general version of this alert needs a shared 'beat task heartbeat' gauge instrumented at the end of every beat task, labeled by task name, which Phase 5 does not add. Staged here so the gap is visible.
